newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki wins FIM 45 mln pipe order.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki wins FIM 45 mln pipe order.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said on Friday its Metform unit won an order worth 45 million markka to deliver water pipes to Norwegian wholesaler Brodrene Dahl A/S.
The pipes are for a water pipeline to be built in southern Norway. "Deliveries will start in March 1997 and continue until the second half of 1999," Rautaruukki said.
"The client is the Tonsberg water company," it said.
The pipes will be coated externally with polythene and will have an internal lining of concrete," Rautaruukki said.
Rautaruukki will also supply various pipe components for the pipeline, it said.
"The water pipeline being laid now ... will be extended after 1999 and the work will continue until the year 2003," Rautaruukki said, adding steel was the best material for mains water pipes.
